children: October 3, 2026 11:07:26 UTC
XRP Utility Expands Beyond Payments With DeFi and Tokenized RWAs
At XRP Seoul 2026, Evernorth CEO Asheesh Birla and Flare cofounder Hugo Philion discussed expanding XRP utility beyond payments. The discussion focused on
DeFi, tokenized real-world assets, yield and on-chain capital markets
, highlighting broader use cases for XRP and blockchain-based financial infrastructure.
October 3, 2026 11:01:18 UTC
Cybersecurity and Liquidity Challenge Tokenized Asset Growth

Liquidity and cybersecurity remain key obstacles to the wider adoption of tokenized assets, according to industry leaders at XRP Seoul 2026. Building sufficient trading volume and deep liquidity pools remains a challenge, while institutions are also preparing for emerging threats involving AI-driven attacks and quantum computing. Strengthening digital asset security is becoming increasingly important as tokenization expands.
October 3, 2026 11:01:18 UTC
Regulatory Uncertainty and AML Remain Tokenization Barriers

Regulatory uncertainty and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) requirements remain major challenges for institutional adoption of tokenized assets, according to discussions at XRP Seoul 2026. Financial institutions are also focused on counterparty and operational risks. Panelists stressed the importance of preventing tokenized assets from reaching sanctioned wallets as the market expands.
October 3, 2026 11:01:18 UTC
Traditional Finance Pushes Tokenization Into Real-World Use

Financial institutions are moving tokenization beyond pilot projects toward practical financial products, according to a panel at XRP Seoul 2026. Industry leaders emphasized partnerships between financial institutions and regulated technology providers as key to connecting traditional finance with blockchain infrastructure. Tokenized assets could eventually support real-world uses such as collateral for everyday credit card spending.
October 3, 2026 11:01:18 UTC
Robinhood Brings DeFi Yields and Tokenized Stocks to Retail Users

Robinhood is integrating with DeFi lending protocols to give its funded users access to on-chain yields and tokenized equities. The approach is designed to simplify access to on-chain finance without requiring users to manage private keys or seed phrases. The move connects Robinhood’s traditional brokerage users with blockchain-based financial products.
October 3, 2026 11:01:18 UTC
Robinhood Plans to Expand Perpetuals Beyond Crypto

Robinhood plans to expand its perpetual trading offerings beyond crypto into commodities such as gold, silver and oil, according to SVP Johann Kerbrat at XRP Seoul 2026. The platform currently offers perpetuals for eight crypto assets. Robinhood has also announced 24/7 stock trading as it looks to serve demand for trading outside traditional market hours.
October 3, 2026 07:56:09 UTC
Tria Expands Self-Custodial Finance to 150 Countries

ria has expanded its self-custodial financial platform to 150 countries, offering decentralized trading across digital assets, commodities and equities. The platform combines wallet services with spending, trading and borrowing features. Tria says its growth is supported through community referrals and an ambassador program rather than paid marketing.
October 3, 2026 07:55:02 UTC
Tria Lets Users Borrow Against XRP and Spend Through Visa Card

Tria is integrating XRP-based borrowing and everyday payments through its Visa card, allowing users to access funds without selling their XRP. Users can borrow against their holdings, earn yield and route earnings toward card spending. The Tria Visa card offers up to 6% cashback, according to the XRP Seoul 2026 keynote.
October 3, 2026 07:45:48 UTC
Tria Launches XRP and RLUSD Self-Custodial Neobank

Tria is positioning its platform as a self-custodial neobank for XRP and RLUSD, allowing users to manage digital assets without giving up control of their funds. The multi-chain wallet supports XRP and RLUSD alongside features for swapping and trading assets. Tria CSO John Lilic discussed the platform during an XRP Seoul 2026 keynote.
October 3, 2026 07:45:48 UTC
XRP Asia Targets Korea and APAC for XRPL Startup Growth

XRP Asia is planning deeper collaboration with local XRPL communities across Asia, with South Korea identified as an important ecosystem market.The organization plans to work with regional hubs such as XRPL Korea to develop startups and strengthen developer communities. The initiative is designed to help local projects expand internationally while increasing XRPL adoption across major Asian markets.
October 3, 2026 07:44:13 UTC
XRP Asia to Fund Startups and Support XRPL Developers

XRP Asia plans to support XRPL developers and startups through training, micro-grants, early-stage investments and go-to-market assistance. Its strategy focuses on four areas: technology, startup success, community and marketing. The organization will also target retail applications, AI-powered payments and enterprise use cases beyond traditional financial technology.
October 3, 2026 07:44:13 UTC
Ripple Unveils XRP Asia to Expand XRPL Across APAC

Ripple has unveiled XRP Asia, an independent entity focused on expanding the XRP Ledger ecosystem across the Asia-Pacific region. XRP Asia will be led by Sabrina Tachdjian, formerly a VP at the Hedera Foundation. The organization will operate independently with strategic backing from Ripple, the XRPL Foundation and XRPL Commons, following a model similar to Europe’s XRPL Commons.
October 3, 2026 07:42:41 UTC
Kyobo Securities Highlights Tokenization’s Role in 24/7 Liquidity

Kyobo Securities highlighted collateral mobility and liquidity as key benefits of tokenized assets during an XRP Seoul 2026 panel on blockchain and financial markets. The discussion pointed to assets such as money market funds (MMFs), where tokenization could enable 24/7 movement of collateral and liquidity. The shift could also expand the role of banks from traditional intermediaries toward platforms managing programmable digital and traditional assets.
October 3, 2026 07:39:30 UTC
Woori Bank and Kbank Explore Real-Time Blockchain Settlement

Woori Bank and Kbank are exploring blockchain-based infrastructure to modernize back-end financial settlement, according to discussions at XRP Seoul 2026. The banks highlighted the potential to move away from fragmented legacy ledgers and reduce T+1 and T+2 settlement delays. On-chain infrastructure could support near-instant transactions and continuous financial operations around the clock.
October 3, 2026 07:38:37 UTC
JB Bank Plans Ripple-Powered Remittances to Southeast Asia

JB Bank has signed with Ripple Payments to launch personal remittances to Southeast Asia, including Vietnam, by mid-December, according to an XRP Seoul 2026 panel. The Korean bank plans to introduce corporate remittances later and is targeting a stablecoin-based remittance service, subject to expected legislation in the first half of next year.
October 3, 2026 07:33:12 UTC
T54 Builds Trust Layer for AI Agents With KYA and Spending Controls

T54 is developing a trust and identity framework for AI agents operating in digital commerce. The system includes KYA (Know Your Agent) verification, user-defined spending limits and on-chain dispute and chargeback mechanisms. The framework is designed to connect AI agents with financial networks and merchants while reducing risks linked to autonomous transactions. Partners cited in the XRP Seoul 2026 keynote include Ripple, Mastercard and AWS.
October 3, 2026 07:33:12 UTC
T54 Launches Agentic Wallet on XRPL for Automated Payments

T54 has introduced a native agentic wallet on the XRP Ledger designed to let AI agents execute payments within user-defined limits. The wallet allows agents to receive pre-approval for transactions and use XRP or RLUSD for payments. The system is designed to give users greater control over automated transactions while enabling AI agents to handle purchases and other payment-related tasks.
October 3, 2026 07:30:00 UTC
XRP Ledger Processes 2.7M Daily Transactions as AI Agents Drive 25%

The XRP Ledger is processing more than 2.7 million daily transactions, with AI agents accounting for 25% of activity, according to the XRP Seoul 2026 keynote on building a trusted agentic economy. The growing AI-agent activity highlights XRPL’s role in automated payments. Its low-cost and fast settlement capabilities allow agents to transact using XRP and RLUSD while operating within predefined user spending limits.
October 3, 2026 07:30:00 UTC
Monica Long: XRPL Targets $30B Tokenized RWA Market

At XRP Seoul 2026, Ripple President Monica Long highlighted the XRP Ledger’s growing focus on institutional use cases. Tokenized real-world assets (RWAs) are projected to grow from $6 billion to $30 billion, while AI agent transactions could increase from 10 million to 100 million. XRPL is being positioned for tokenization, lending, collateral mobility and global payments, supporting its broader institutional adoption strategy.
